name: Misbah ul Iman
bio: alesforce Technical Architect with 20+ years of enterprise experience, 10-year Salesforce Community Group Leader, and Co-Organizer of Dubai Dreamin’. Host of The Franken Org podcast—a platform created after seeing too many Frankenstein-like orgs struggling to innovate. Dedicated to helping teams clean up legacy technical debt and refactor messy architectures so they can safely deploy next-generation solutions like Agentforce.

name: Frankie (The Frankenstein)
bio: Frankie is a seasoned Salesforce technical expert and co-host of The Franken Org. Operating anonymously to share raw, unfiltered truths about enterprise technical debt, Frankie keeps his personal identity off the grid, a decision we completely respect. He brings decades of hands-on experience refactoring monster orgs and preparing complex architectures for next-gen AI.
